title: ‼️IMPORTANT‼️
message:
Attendance formula updated to match official KL ERP condonation!

• BEFORE: (Attended + TCBR) ÷ Conducted
• NOW (Official ERP): Attended ÷ (Conducted - TCBR)

TCBR condones conducted hours. You can also use the new TCBR ON/OFF button in Attendance to compare raw vs condoned stats anytime!
